card.title: Hope Keeps Moving
card.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our bookshop failed here. We're meant to find readers somewhere else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're meant to start smaller. One shelf, properly chosen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I could get us a market stall beside the bus stop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People waiting with nothing to read! I'll pack the short stories. We've been making our customers come too far.

mechanism: A interprets business failure and reduced resources as the route to the bookshop finding its real readers.
confusable: Unlike pragmatic troubleshooting alone, each adjustment must be presented as what the venture was meant to become.
comparison: Commercial partners accept a smaller stall, unlike the wedding couple changing place and date around family.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
